name: pivot
description: Create an Excel PivotTable from a Table or range using live headers

tools.name: create_pivot
tools.description: Create a PivotTable on a new sheet. Field names must match live headers from inspect. rows/columns/filters are header names; values are [{field, aggregation}] with aggregation sum|count|average|min|max.

tableName.description: Source Excel Table name from ensure_table / inspect

sourceRange.description: A1 range including headers if not using tableName
